question:
Which of the following is/are example(s) of exothermic reaction?

i. Making of slaked lime

ii. Burning of natural gas

iii. Respiration
solution:
The correct answer is __**2 Only**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An **exothermic reaction** is a chemical reaction that releases energy by light or heat.
 
• Examples of exothermic reactions include:
 
 
• **Making of slaked lime** (Calcium oxide reacts with water to form calcium hydroxide and releases heat.)
 
• **Burning of natural gas** (Methane reacts with oxygen to produce carbon dioxide, water, and heat.)
 
• **Respiration** (Glucose reacts with oxygen in our cells to produce carbon dioxide, water, and energy.)
 
 
 
• Therefore, all the given reactions, i.e., making of slaked lime, burning of natural gas, and respiration, are examples of exothermic reactions.
